items.description:
First Car Rental Centurion is a car and van rental branch of First Car Rental's national South African network, at 2 Larch Nook, Centurion Central. The chain operates branches across South Africa's main cities and airports, giving customers a familiar, well-established option for vehicle hire.

The Centurion branch serves local residents, business travellers and visitors who need a rental car for personal or work travel, including customers whose own vehicle is temporarily unavailable. It trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm and Saturday from 8am to 1pm. As part of a national rental network, the branch follows First Car Rental's standard booking and service process, giving Centurion customers convenient local access to a recognised rental brand without travelling to the airport or another city branch.

Golden Globe Distributors is a general dealer and industrial-supplies distributor at Pyramid Business Park, 21 Rudolph Street, Sunderland Ridge, Centurion. Its website lists personal protective equipment such as masks, gloves, face shields and protective clothing for workplace safety and compliance, alongside pallet wraps for securing goods during transit.

The business serves companies and tradespeople needing PPE and general dealer supplies for their operations, positioning itself as a supplier that can be contacted directly for a quote on specific products. It trades weekday mornings and afternoons from 9:30am to 5pm. Golden Globe Distributors gives businesses in Centurion and the wider Pretoria area a local supplier for workplace safety equipment and packaging materials, rather than sourcing from a larger national distributor.

Health Oasis Lynnridge Mall is a health and wellness retailer at Shop 33A, Lynnridge Mall, on the corner of Lynnwood Road and Jacobson Avenue in Lynnwood Ridge, Pretoria. It serves local residents and shoppers at Lynnridge Mall looking for health and wellness products, giving the centre a dedicated health-focused retail option alongside its other stores.

The store trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 5:30pm and Saturday mornings until 2pm, and is closed on Sundays. Health Oasis suits shoppers in Lynnwood Ridge and the surrounding suburbs who want to pick up health and wellness products while already at Lynnridge Mall, without needing to travel to a larger pharmacy or health store elsewhere in Pretoria.

Mida Bakery Supplies CC is a bakery-supplies business at 266 Stormvoel Road, Jan Niemand Park, Pretoria, serving bakeries and food businesses that need baking equipment and ingredients. It has been in business for some years, operating as a dedicated bakery-supplies retailer rather than a general grocery or hardware store.

The business trades Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 5pm and Saturday mornings until 1pm, and is closed on Sundays. Mida Bakery Supplies CC suits commercial and home bakers in the Jan Niemand Park and wider Pretoria area who need a specialist local supplier for bakery equipment and ingredients, rather than sourcing from a general retailer or travelling further afield.

Pick n Pay Waterkloof Rand is a branch of the national Pick n Pay supermarket chain at Shop 1, on the corner of Buffelsdrift Street and Rigel Avenue, Waterkloof Rand Centre, Erasmusrand. It offers the standard Pick n Pay range of groceries, fresh produce, meat, bakery and household essentials, serving residents and families in Erasmusrand and the surrounding Pretoria East suburbs for everyday grocery shopping.

The branch trades long hours daily, from 8am to 7pm on weekdays, 8am to 5pm on Saturdays and 8am to 4pm on Sundays. As part of a national chain, the store's product range follows the broader Pick n Pay format, giving Erasmusrand shoppers a convenient full-range supermarket close to home.

Sorbet Salon Groenkloof is a beauty salon at Shop 9, Groenkloof Plaza, on the corner of George Storrar Drive and Bronkhorst Street, Groenkloof, Pretoria, part of the national Sorbet salon franchise. It offers facials and skincare, hair removal including eyebrow and lip threading, makeup application, massage and dermaplaning facials, bookable in advance through the salon.

It serves clients in Groenkloof and the surrounding suburbs looking for professional beauty and grooming treatments in a franchise salon setting. The branch trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 6pm, Saturday from 8am to 5pm and Sunday from 9am to 2pm. Sorbet Salon Groenkloof suits clients who want a recognised beauty-franchise standard of treatment close to home in Pretoria's eastern suburbs.

A1 Car Service is an automotive workshop at 1086 Bokmakierie Street, Theresapark, Pretoria, and is part of the Retail Motor Industry Organisation network, giving it access to current automotive diagnostic equipment and technical software. The workshop services and repairs all makes of cars, with technicians who undergo ongoing training to keep pace with vehicle technology.

It serves motorists in Theresapark and the surrounding area who want a workshop equipped to diagnose and repair modern vehicles accurately rather than relying on guesswork. A1 Car Service trades Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 5pm, with Saturday appointments available on request. It suits motorists looking for a properly equipped, RMI-affiliated local workshop for servicing and repairs rather than a franchise dealership.

Absa Bank Northpark Mall is a branch of Absa, one of South Africa's major banks, at Northpark Mall, 526 Rachel de Beer Street, Pretoria North. It offers standard retail banking services such as account transactions, deposits and general banking enquiries for customers in the Pretoria North and Akasia area.

The branch trades Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 3:30pm and Saturday mornings from 8am to 11am, and is closed on Sundays. Being inside Northpark Mall makes it a convenient stop for shoppers who want to handle their banking while already at the centre. Absa Bank Northpark Mall suits customers in Pretoria North who want in-person banking services without travelling further into the city.

Black Block Cafe is a casual fast-food restaurant at 86 Mokwerekwere Street, Lotus Gardens, Pretoria, offering dine-in and takeout meals at affordable prices. It has built a reputation locally for quick service and a welcoming, relaxed atmosphere, making it a popular choice for groups as well as individual diners.

The cafe serves residents of Lotus Gardens and the surrounding area looking for a convenient, budget-friendly lunch or dinner option without a long wait. It trades seven days a week, from 10am to 10pm daily. Black Block Cafe suits customers who want a casual, affordable meal close to home, whether eating in or taking food away, rather than a sit-down restaurant experience.

Clicks Pharmacy Southdowns is a branch of the national Clicks pharmacy and health-and-beauty chain at Southdowns Shopping Centre, on the corner of John Vorster Drive and Karee Street, Irene, Centurion. It offers pharmacy services alongside Clicks' usual range of beauty, skincare, makeup and personal-care products.

The branch serves residents of Irene and Southdowns, as well as shoppers already at the centre who want to combine a pharmacy visit with everyday health and beauty shopping. Trading hours vary slightly through the week: 8am to 7pm Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday, 9am to 7pm Wednesday, 8am to 5pm Saturday and 9am to 5pm Sunday. Clicks Pharmacy Southdowns suits Centurion shoppers wanting a full-range pharmacy and health retailer in one convenient centre.

Computer Haven is a computer sales and repair business at 1002 Hertzog Street, Villieria, Pretoria, offering sales, repairs, virus removal, data recovery and internet-related services. It serves residents and small businesses in Villieria and the surrounding Pretoria suburbs who need help with a slow, infected or malfunctioning computer, as well as customers looking to buy new equipment.

The business trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and can also be reached by phone or WhatsApp for support queries. Computer Haven suits anyone in the Villieria area who wants a local, independent computer shop for repairs, data recovery or general IT support rather than a large national electronics retailer.

Debonairs Pizza Ninapark is a branch of the national Debonairs Pizza chain at Northdale Shopping Centre, Grafenheim Street, Ninapark, Pretoria North, offering pizza, sides and the chain's regular specials for dine-in, takeaway and delivery. It serves residents of Ninapark and the surrounding Pretoria North suburbs looking for a quick, affordable pizza meal for a family dinner, lunch or takeaway order.

The branch trades long hours most days, generally from 10am until 9pm or 10pm depending on the day of the week. As part of a well-known national chain, Debonairs Pizza Ninapark follows the brand's standard menu and ordering options, including online ordering, giving Ninapark customers a familiar, convenient pizza option close to home.

Edgars Soshanguve Crossing is a branch of the national Edgars clothing and department-store chain, at the corner of Ruth First and Aubrey Matlala streets in Soshanguve Crossing shopping centre, Soshanguve. It offers Edgars' usual range of clothing, footwear and household goods for the whole family, serving residents of Soshanguve and the surrounding area who want a full department-store shopping option without travelling further into Pretoria.

The branch trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 6pm, Saturday from 9am to 5pm and Sunday from 9am to 3pm. As part of a national chain, its product range follows the broader Edgars format, giving Soshanguve Crossing shoppers convenient local access to the brand's clothing and homeware ranges.

Engen Bakenkop Service Station is a 24-hour fuel station at 406 Theuns van Niekerk Street, Wierdapark, Centurion, offering round-the-clock refuelling for motorists. The station includes a Woolworths Foodstop convenience store, where customers can buy groceries, snacks, ready meals and freshly brewed coffee alongside filling up, with the option to earn FNB eBucks rewards at the pumps.

It serves motorists travelling through Wierdapark at any hour, as well as local residents stopping in for a quick grocery or coffee run. Being open 24 hours makes it a reliable option for late-night or early-morning fuel and convenience shopping. Engen Bakenkop suits drivers who want fuel and a convenience-store stop in one place, at any time of day or night.

Galaxis Technologies is a software development company at 174 Baard Road, Raslouw, Centurion, that has developed software solutions for more than 15 years with a specialisation in the accounting industry. The company focuses on building dedicated software products rather than offering general IT support or hardware sales.

It serves accounting firms and businesses in Centurion and the wider Gauteng area that need specialised accounting-related software rather than off-the-shelf general business tools. Galaxis Technologies' long track record in this niche makes it a relevant option for accounting practices and finance teams looking for software built specifically around their industry's needs, rather than a generic software provider without that specific track record.

JDP Speed is an automotive service and repair workshop at 210 Kameeldrift Road, Roodeplaat, Pretoria, offering vehicle servicing and repairs using current diagnostic equipment and Behr Hella automotive parts. The workshop emphasises fully qualified staff and keeping pace with ongoing developments in automotive technology, so that servicing and repair work matches what modern vehicles need.

It serves motorists in Kameeldrift, Roodeplaat and the surrounding areas who need a car serviced or repaired by a workshop equipped for current vehicle technology. Customers can contact the workshop directly by phone or email to arrange a service or repair. JDP Speed suits motorists looking for a well-equipped independent workshop rather than a dealership service centre.

Absa Branch Laudium is a branch of Absa, one of South Africa's major banks, at Shop 5, Laudium Plaza, on Tangerine Street in Laudium, Pretoria. It offers standard retail banking services for customers in Laudium and the surrounding western Pretoria suburbs, including everyday account transactions and general banking enquiries.

The branch trades Monday to Friday from 8:30am to 3:30pm and Saturday mornings from 8am to 11am, and is closed on Sundays. Being inside Laudium Plaza makes it a convenient stop for shoppers already at the centre who need to handle banking in person. Absa Branch Laudium suits residents of Laudium who want in-person banking services close to home rather than travelling into central Pretoria.

Alpha Pharm Distributors is a cargo and freight distribution business at 115 Fascia Road, Silvertondale, Pretoria, offering logistics and transport services with a focus on reliable, accurate deliveries. The business operates from a well-equipped facility and emphasises professional, efficient service for its clients' shipments.

It serves businesses in Silvertondale and the wider Pretoria area that need dependable freight and distribution services for their goods, rather than managing logistics in-house. Alpha Pharm Distributors trades Monday to Friday from 7:30am to 4pm. It suits businesses looking for a local logistics partner that can handle the practical side of freight distribution, from collection through to timely, accurate delivery.

By Word Constructors is a building and maintenance contractor at 1291 Hjalmer Street, Booysens, Pretoria, offering maintenance, electrical work, plumbing, general building, reinstatements and fencing. The business positions itself as a practical, general-purpose contractor able to take on a range of building and property-maintenance jobs rather than specialising narrowly in one trade.

It serves homeowners, landlords and property managers in Booysens and the surrounding Pretoria area who need building, electrical, plumbing or fencing work done, including reinstatement work after damage or renovation. By Word Constructors suits customers who want one local contractor able to handle several different types of property work rather than hiring separate specialists for each job.

Design Team Fabrics is a textile design and printing business at 71 Jean Avenue, Doringkloof, Centurion, focused on African-inspired fabric prints and designs. The business sells its printed fabrics and textile products online, with trackable delivery to addresses across South Africa and a returns policy allowing items to be sent back within 7 days.

It serves customers nationwide who want distinctively African-patterned fabrics and textiles for clothing, decor or craft projects, not just local Centurion buyers. Design Team Fabrics suits designers, crafters and shoppers looking for fabric with a specifically African design identity, bought online and delivered rather than selected in person from a physical fabric shop.

Dis-Chem Soshanguve Crossing is a branch of the national Dis-Chem pharmacy chain at Soshanguve Crossing Mall, on the corner of Ruth First Road and Aubrey Matlala Street, Soshanguve. The branch includes a dispensary offering click-and-collect prescriptions and clinic services, with its own dispensary contact details for prescription-related queries.

It serves residents of Soshanguve and the surrounding area who need pharmacy, dispensary or clinic services, alongside Dis-Chem's usual range of health, beauty and personal-care products. The branch trades Monday to Friday from 9am to 7pm, Saturday from 8am to 5pm and Sunday from 9am to 3pm. Dis-Chem Soshanguve Crossing suits shoppers who want a full-service pharmacy with clinic and dispensary facilities in one Soshanguve location.

EnviroServ Rosslyn Depot is a depot of EnviroServ, a subsidiary of the global SUEZ group, at 12 Piet Rautenbach Street, Rosslyn, Pretoria. EnviroServ offers environmental management services covering waste, water and wastewater management, combining operational expertise with a focus on sustainability and the circular economy.

The Rosslyn depot serves businesses and industrial clients in the Rosslyn area and wider Pretoria that need waste or water-management services handled by an established environmental-services provider rather than managing it themselves. As part of a large, internationally backed group, EnviroServ brings established processes and expertise to its environmental contracts. The Rosslyn depot suits industrial and commercial clients in the area who need professional waste or water-management support.

Fahrenheit Sublimation is a garment printing and sublimation business at 5 Migmatite Drive, Zwartkop, Centurion, specialising in branded uniforms, sports kits and custom apparel for resellers and trade customers. The business sources quality apparel for printing and offers nationwide delivery across Centurion, Pretoria, Johannesburg and greater Gauteng.

It serves businesses, sports clubs and resellers who need branded or custom-printed clothing produced at scale, rather than individual one-off print jobs. Fahrenheit Sublimation trades Monday to Friday from 8am to 5pm, and customers can reach the business by phone, WhatsApp or email to discuss garment supply and printing needs. It suits businesses and clubs across Gauteng looking for a dedicated sublimation and garment-printing supplier for uniforms and sports kits.

GML Engineering is an engineering and industrial-supplies provider at 343 Parsley Avenue, Annlin, Pretoria, offering engineering services and a range of industrial products to support manufacturing projects. The business provides practical, tailored engineering solutions and expert guidance to clients working on manufacturing and industrial projects, combining specialised products with hands-on consultation.

It serves manufacturers and industrial businesses in Annlin and the wider Pretoria area that need engineering input or industrial supplies for their operations, rather than sourcing separately from multiple suppliers. GML Engineering suits manufacturing businesses looking for one local, practical engineering partner that can both supply products and advise on how to apply them to a specific project.

Guest Resource Services is an accredited training provider at 41 Theron Street, Clarina, Pretoria, offering learnerships, full qualifications, short attendance courses, recognition of prior learning and broader skills programmes across various SETAs. The business is registered as an assessment centre for a range of qualifications, and its training also covers people with disabilities and differently-abled learners.

It serves employers across various sectors who want to develop their workforce through accredited training, as well as individuals seeking qualifications or skills development through SETA-aligned programmes. Guest Resource Services suits businesses looking for a single accredited partner to handle learnerships, assessments and skills training, rather than coordinating separate training and assessment providers.

Gym Company Boekenhoutskloof is a branch of the national Gym Company fitness chain at 257 Boom Street, Pretoria Central, offering gym facilities with notably long opening hours. The branch opens from as early as 4:30am on weekdays and closes as late as 9pm on Tuesdays to Fridays, with weekend hours from 6am to 5pm on Saturdays and 7am to 5pm on Sundays. This makes it a practical option for members who want to train before work in the early morning or later in the evening.

It serves residents and workers in and around Pretoria Central who want flexible gym access as part of a national fitness-chain membership. Gym Company Boekenhoutskloof suits early-morning or evening gym-goers who value long opening hours over a boutique studio setting.
